subject: calderMobile
pitch:
Category: Abstract.
Subject: hanging mobile.
Style: Alexander Calder.

spec.name: Calder Mobile
spec.description: A hanging abstract mobile in the manner of Alexander Calder: a ceiling hook and black wires carrying balanced arms, with flat red, yellow, blue, white and black sheet-metal shapes hung in a cascade that reaches down to the floor.
spec.layout: STATIC model (joints: []), centred on x = 0, standing on y = 0. It hangs from one ceiling hook at the top, y = 2.78. A thin black wire runs down to the top arm (A). Below it the mobile splits into a right (+X) cascade and a left (-X) cascade, and the right cascade ends in a low tier whose biggest black leaf just touches y = 0. Arms are thin black tapered rods in the horizontal plane at the stated y. Their yaws differ (A along X, B and D diagonal, C along X, E and F along Z), so the mobile reads as 3D from every side. Every hanging element uses one convention: a straight vertical black wire (radius 0.004, 5 sides) runs from a small black wire loop (torus, tube 0.006, radius 0.02) on the arm end down to a small eyelet ring on the top point of the shape. Shapes are flat sheet-metal cutouts (extrude, thickness 0.012, tiny bevel) in a vertical plane. The plane's normal is the local +Z turned by the stated yaw about Y, and the shape hangs so its top eyelet is directly under the wire. Every shape also gets a darker twin of its colour, 4% larger and 0.006 thick, seated just behind its back face, which reads as a painted edge. A few shapes get a small contrasting inset dot or ring as a separate part (Calder's cut-out accents). All balanced pivots are marked by 3 tiny coil rings (torus) wrapped on the arm at the pivot, plus a tiny black ball of radius 0.025 on each arm tip beyond the loop. Style: bold primary colours (red, yellow, blue) with white and black, flat, thin, airy and sparse; wires are the structure and the shapes are the weight. Nothing sits on the floor but the lowest leaf tip. No ground, no stand, no extras.

parts.builds: Top of the mobile. A small round ceiling plate (plate colour, r 0.07, thick 0.015, centred y 2.81, seated at the ceilingHook) with a steel S-hook or ring under it. A black wire (r 0.005) from ceilingHook straight down to topPivot. Arm A: a tapered black rod along X from topEndL to topEndR at y 2.4, radius 0.012 tapering to 0.007 at each end, with a loop torus at each end and a tiny black ball past each tip. Three coil rings and a small steel clamp collar at topPivot where the wire joins. One small hanging yellow leaf (length 0.28, width 0.14, leaf or lens outline, yaw 40 degrees) on a 0.12 long wire from midHangA. Its eyelet is at [0.3,2.28,0], so the centre is at about [0.3,2.14,0]. Give it a yellowDark twin and a small white inset dot. Does NOT build the wires below topEndL or topEndR; those belong to the child parts, which attach to the loops here.
parts.attaches: Arm ends topEndL and topEndR carry loops where the leftCascade and rightCascade wires hang. The ceilingHook is the model's top.

parts.builds: Middle right (+X) tier. Wire from topEndR down to rightPivot. Arm B: a tapered black rod from rightEndBack to rightEndFront at y 1.8 (diagonal in XZ), with coil rings at rightPivot and a loop and tip ball at each end. Big red disc (radius 0.2) with a redDark twin, hung from rightEndFront by a 0.32 wire, centre [1.3,1.28,0.5], yaw 25 degrees. It has a small white ring and a small ink dot on its face as inset accents. Wire from rightEndBack down to rightPivot2. Arm C: a tapered black rod along X from cLeft to cRight at y 1.3, coil rings at rightPivot2, loops and tip balls at both ends. A yellow leaf (length 0.4, width 0.22, pointed leaf outline, yaw -35 degrees) hung from cLeft by a 0.15 wire, eyelet [0.15,1.15,-0.4], centre about [0.15,0.95,-0.4], with a yellowDark twin and a thin ink midrib line as a part. A small blue disc (r 0.09, blueDark twin, yaw 0) hung from cBlueHang by a 0.22 wire, centre about [0.92,0.97,-0.4]. Does NOT build the wire from cRight downward (the lowTier owns it); it only builds the loop at cRight.
parts.attaches: Hangs from topEndR (crown). The loop at cRight carries the wire of the lowTier.

parts.builds: Lowest tier, below cRight. A black wire from cRight straight down to lowPivot. Arm F: a tapered black rod along Z from fBack to fFront at y 0.85, with three coil rings at lowPivot, loops and tip balls at the ends. The big black leaf hangs from fFront on a 0.15 wire. It is a tall elegant leaf or blade outline 0.7 tall and 0.3 wide, yaw 60 degrees, eyelet at [1.2,0.70,0.25], centre [1.2,0.35,0.25]. Its lowest tip is at y = 0.0, the lowest point of the whole model. Colour ink with a wire-colour twin behind, plus a white midrib line and 3 small white dots as inset accents. A blue disc (radius 0.14, blueDark twin, yaw 0) hangs from fBack on a 0.25 wire, centre [1.2,0.46,-1.05], with a white ring inset and a small red dot at its centre. Add a small red ball of radius 0.05 on a 0.3 wire hung from lowPivot-adjacent point [1.2,0.85,-0.12] on arm F, so it hangs between the two large shapes.
parts.attaches: Wire top at cRight (rightCascade loop). Nothing else attaches below.

parts.builds: Upper left (-X) tier. Wire from topEndL down to leftPivot (a 0.5 black wire). Arm D: a tapered black rod diagonal in XZ from leftEndA to leftEndB at y 1.9, with coil rings and a steel collar at leftPivot, and loops and tip balls at both ends. A large yellow disc (radius 0.22, yellowDark twin, yaw -20 degrees) hung from leftEndB by a 0.3 wire, centre [-0.2,1.38,-0.45]. It has a black concentric ring inset (outer r 0.12, inner r 0.1) and a black centre dot of r 0.03 as separate parts. A small white ball (radius 0.05) hung from the arm at [-0.45,1.9,-0.225] by a 0.2 wire, centre y 1.65. Also a thin curly black wire spiral (a flat swept spiral of 1.5 turns, radius 0.05, 0.003 thick) hanging 0.2 below leftEndA is NOT built; leftLower owns that wire. Builds only the loop at leftEndA.
parts.attaches: Hangs from topEndL (crown). The loop at leftEndA carries the wire of the leftLower tier.

parts.builds: Lower left (-X) tier. A black wire from leftEndA down to leftSub (0.55 long). Arm E: a tapered black rod along Z from eBack to eFront at y 1.35, with coil rings and a steel collar at leftSub and loops and tip balls at the ends. A red kidney or crescent leaf (length 0.36, width 0.2, redDark twin, yaw 70 degrees) hung from eFront by a 0.15 wire, eyelet [-1.2,1.2,0.85], centre about [-1.2,1.02,0.85], with 2 small white dots inset. A black fish or teardrop leaf (length 0.5, width 0.22, wire-colour twin, yaw -50 degrees) hung from eBack by a 0.3 wire, eyelet [-1.2,1.05,-0.15], centre about [-1.2,0.8,-0.15], with a thin white midrib line and a small yellow dot. A small white disc (r 0.07, yaw 90) on a thin 0.15 wire hung from the arm at [-1.2,1.35,0.2]. A coiled spring: a thin black wire spiral (3 turns, radius 0.035, tube 0.003) hanging down from leftSub, 0.2 long, ending in a small blue ball r 0.04.
